run_findings.control26_nonregression: Strict zero-residual-executor, zero-optional-monthly-quota, zero-incremental-cost acceptance remains authoritative; control25 relaxation is not imported.
run_findings.rmcp_macro_router_first: At exact rmcp-v3.1.4, #[tool_handler] auto-generates call_tool as ToolCallContext::new -> ToolRouter.call whenever the ServerHandler impl does not define call_tool. This upgrades the router-first seam from a source-equivalent proposal to an exact macro-supported dispatch shape.
run_findings.rmcp_standard_extractors:
Registered tool handlers can receive RequestContext, Parameters

, RequestState and InputResponses through standard FromContextPart extraction before method invocation. Malformed Parameters fail before the handler body.
run_findings.rmcp_mrtr_upstream_test: The exact-release MacroMrtrServer upstream test already exercises a registered tool taking Parameters + RequestState + InputResponses and returning Result<CallToolResponse, ErrorData>, with InputRequired on the first round and completion on retry over a real client/server pair.
run_findings.rmcp_task_return_type: CallToolResponse directly implements IntoCallToolResult, so a registered handler is source-type-compatible with CallToolResponse::Task. The exact task E2E test still materializes Task in a manual call_tool override, so registered-handler Task creation is not claimed locally/upstream-runtime-tested by this worker.
run_findings.rmcp_get_info_shape: #[tool_handler] preserves a user-defined get_info while generating missing call_tool. A router-first task server can therefore retain explicit enable_tools()+enable_tasks() capability advertisement; the macro's autogenerated get_info alone does not enable Tasks.
run_findings.rmcp_post_guard_window: Exact upstream AlwaysTaskServer calls TaskManager.spawn before returning Task, while the E2E dispatch test then rejects that Task response for a non-declaring client. Therefore the generic post-handler capability guard is a response/wire safeguard, not a pre-materialization fence. The well-behaved TaskServer separately prechecks client Tasks capability before spawn.
run_findings.rmcp_local_compile_boundary: A source-qualified router-first TaskServer candidate was saved, but local compile/runtime verification is blocked because cargo is unavailable in this worker runtime. No local compile success is claimed.
run_findings.rmcp_stock_task_boundary: Router-first parity does not solve stock TaskManager persistence, caller-stable create-or-get, lost-CreateTaskResult recovery, server-restart redrive, or external-effect duplicate safety; these remain separate unresolved children.
run_findings.openhands_r7_carry: OpenHands v1.44.1 R7 remains an unresolved continuation: pure marker/event/generation/head validation, off-object final snapshot, one guarded LocalFileStore atomic write, silent bookkeeping sync and cleanup; arbitrary custom FileStore atomicity and full power-loss durability must not be assumed.
run_findings.phase1_boundary: All completed source inspection, role-local artifact persistence and local capability checks were Chat-native, used no finite paid/trial/monthly hosted quota feature and had zero incremental monetary cost. Persistent custom MCP runtime/storage, local Rust compilation and OpenHands patch execution remain unresolved children.
